283496090.description:
C. Marsden Huggins
Portrait of an Elder Smoking a Pipe
Art Print on Paper
19" x 23" (Framed)
Signed in print lower left
This evocative portrait by Zimbabwean artist Cleta Marsden-Huggins depicts an African elder cupping his hands around a pipe. Active during the mid-20th century, Marsden-Huggins was celebrated for detailed figurative studies and African wildlife works. This piece showcases the artist's mastery of tonal shading and fine cross-hatching, capturing deep facial character, hands, and draped clothing with striking realistic presence.
Fine monochrome sketch-style print with detailed rendering and expressive texture
Features printed artist signature "C Marsden Huggins" at the lower left
Framed in a black wood frame with off-white mat and ready-to-hang wire on verso
Frame measures approximately 19" wide by 23" high
Condition:
Very good condition overall. The artwork is clean beneath the glass with mild age toning to paper. Frame exhibits minor cosmetic scuffs and edge wear consistent with handling, but remains structurally sound.
